newsitem.title: USA: Maine lawmakers want to open new juvenile facility.
newsitem.headline: Maine lawmakers want to open new juvenile facility.

text.p: Members of the Maine Legislature's Appropriations Committee have decided to fund the opening of the Northern Maine Juvenile Detention facility in Charleston.
The $4.5 million jail was completed last year and has been empty awaiting funding for 100 staff members needed to operate the facility.
Lawmakers grumbled over the fact that the 34-bed jail will cost about $70,000 a year per bed. No final vote has been taken on the center.
